name: Kim Ji-eun
source:
Obsessed with physical strength and pushing her limits, her cute face and bubbly personality hide formidable power. [url=/c166730]AURA[/url] identified her as genetically "perfect," the product of a designed union between Olympic-level parents who met at the 2969 Games. She's everything they engineered her to be, and then some.
